differences: Text A says the enchanted creature can't attack you or planeswalkers you control; Text B says it can't attack at all, which also forbids attacking other players and planeswalkers.
Text B's sentence 'This attack restriction also applies to planeswalkers' does not match Text A, which restricts attacks only on you and planeswalkers you control.
